_comment: Recursion-termination guard, rejection path (components/temporal-workflow.md, 'Resolved: Recursion Termination Guard'), under plan-and-execute. A clearly-Deliberate research task -> PlanWorkflow -> planning turn proposes ONE checkpoint. The checkpoint turn (<turn:1>:cp:1) spawns a subagent; that subagent tries to hand its ENTIRE task to a further subagent with no delegated_scope/kept_work -> rejected at mint time (no <turn:1>:cp:1:sub:1:sub:1 child workflow ever starts, durably recorded as a tool_calls error). The has_tool_calls fix: the subagent must loop back for a follow-up reasoning step to react to the rejection rather than silently ending its turn.

message.content: Research our options for the new caching layer end to end: have a subagent do the literature review while it keeps the synthesis for itself, then give me a recommendation.

scripted_model_responses.content: Plan: delegate the research, keep the recommendation.

checkpoints.intent: Delegate the caching-layer research to a subagent and turn its output into a recommendation
checkpoints.done_when: the subagent has reported back and a recommendation is written

checkpoint_responses.content: Delegating the research to a subagent.

arguments.prompt: Handle the outer caching-layer research task.

scripted_model_responses.content: I'll hand this whole thing off to a further subagent.

arguments.prompt: Do the entire caching-layer research task for me.

scripted_model_responses.content: Understood — that delegation was rejected since I wasn't keeping any work for myself. Performing the task directly instead.

checkpoint_responses.content: Subagent completed the research directly after its nested delegation was rejected. Checkpoint done.
